notes.title: Patch Notes - August 15th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541356/c6f2d00068aa7789b43e94e587b4c4bfa756647d.png

Hello Sparks, 

Today is release day for Phantom Spark, and whilst there have been a few bugs reported, we’re pleased to share our first patch including bug fixes!

Feedback Points

Key rebind, where? We hear you loud and clear! 
Feedback Logged + Workaround for Steam Deck: For our SteamDeck players, you can use a workaround with Steam API via this link

Manually select flag to represent your region.
Feedback Logged: Thank you for the request! 

Track Building, create your own tracks.
Feedback Logged: Thank you for all the requests! We’re glad to see you are enjoying Phantom Spark and would like to create your own tracks. We have logged your feedback request and will update you in the future!


Bugs Fixed

Player names appearing as anonymous for the first time playing.
FIXED: You are no longer anonymous! Your name should now appear. If you are still encountering this bug, please close the game down, restart, and check. 

Game freezing when not in window focus.
FIXED: Your game should no longer freeze when you alt tab/click off screen. 

Game not launching due to audio issue.
TEMP FIX: If there is an issue with audio, the game will still launch without audio, rather than freeze. (We still hope to resolve the audio issues but at least you can play…)

Username not showing up on leaderboards.
FIXED: Your usernames should now be appearing on leaderboards! Make sure to restart your game and check for patches, if you are still encountering this bug. 

Music on pathways not changing from Idle and into new soundtrack variants.
TEMP FIX: Pausing the game, and unpausing, should force the music to update from Idle and into a new track. 


As always, thank you for sharing all of your feedback and any bugs you encounter. Please do continue to share your bugs with us in the official Discord
